item.title: Perth to kick off the Men’s Rugby World Cup 2027 with opening match at Optus Stadium
item.description: Announced just this morning at Cottesloe beach, Perth will officially open the Men’s Rugby World Cup 2027! The Wallabies take on Hong Kong China at Optus Stadium on Friday 1 October, 2027 — and marks the first time the global tournament has ever kicked off in Western Australia. item.title: OMG! Festival returns to light up Kwinana for four nights of art, music and community
item.description: Kwinana is getting ready to glow this summer, with OMG! Festival 2026 returning as a refreshed, four-night celebration of light, storytelling and community. item.description: Over 80 years ago, a group of 16 Aboriginal men working at Birrundudu Station were commissioned to create a collection of 810 drawings. item.description: A new sculpture trail is set to come to Esperance, with leading arts not-for-profit organisation FORM granted $6 million funding from Lotterywest. item.description: A fresh new contemporary art space is about to open in Mount Hawthorn, with a clear mission: give emerging and mid-career Western Australian artists the platform they’ve been missing. item.title: Four new public schools, major upgrades for others on the way for growing Perth suburbs
item.description: Four new public primary schools and major upgrades to existing campuses are on the way, as Perth’s rapidly growing suburbs continue to put pressure on classrooms.
